reference_answer_new: COM_OBL_RC_ACT selects the mode PX4 switches to when offboard control is lost (after the COM_OF_LOSS_T timeout). The Offboard Parameters table lists 0 Position, 1 Altitude, 2 Manual, 3 Return, 4 Land; the Offboard Loss Failsafe table in the safety configuration also lists Hold mode.
